title: Procedural Per-Lod Node Content
description: Give every DAG node a PascalCase name, abbreviation, and icon; rewrite shared DAG host LOD rendering so each zoom tier shows minimap body only, overview icon, compact abbreviation, normal name, detail icon+abbreviation, micro icon+name.
summary: Added PascalCase name, abbreviation, and icon to every DAG node kind (NeuronKindInfo, DagNodeSpec, flow catalogue, brep kinds). Introduced to_pascal_case/normalize_node_display, shared IconPaintCache in directed/types.rs wired into BoardHost and DagHost, and rewrote DagDrawLod content selection: minimap body-only, overview icon, compact abbreviation, normal name, detail icon+abbreviation, micro icon+name. Extended Rust/TS tests and DEBUG lod/icon/label logging on tier changes.
